common.comingInPhase: This screen is built in phase {n}.
common.notConfigured: Supabase isn't configured. Add VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY to .env.local.

login.wrongRole: You're signed in as {role}. This screen is for a different role.
login.title: Sign in
login.lead: We use your phone number so the safe point and police can reach you.

errors.invalid_phone: Enter a Pakistani mobile number, like 0300 1234567.
errors.wrong_code: That code isn't right. Try again.
errors.demo_disabled: Phone sign-in isn't switched on yet (DEMO_MODE).
errors.network_error: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errors.server_error: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
errors.girls_need_women_staff: Girls can only go to a Behan Desk with women staff.
errors.invalid_transition: This case has already moved on. The screen will update.
errors.not_your_case: Only the person who reported this case can do that.
errors.staff_only: Only safe point staff can accept a child.
errors.other_safe_point: This child is heading to a different safe point.
errors.location_required: We need the location to find the nearest safe point.
errors.role_not_allowed: Your account can't file this kind of report.
errors.safe_point_not_found: That safe point isn't available. Choose another.
errors.no_profile: Your account isn't set up. Sign in again.
errors.bad_media_path: A photo or voice note didn't upload properly. Retake it.
errors.create_failed: The report didn't save. Try again; nothing was lost.
errors.not_allowed: You don't have access to this.
errors.signup_failed: Couldn't create your account. Try again.
errors.under4_staff_confirms: For children under 4, the safe point staff confirm the match.
errors.already_decided: Someone already decided on this match.
errors.not_at_safe_point: The child must be accepted at a safe point first.
errors.other_side_not_ready: The family's report isn't ready for this yet. Try again in a moment.
errors.chat_closed: Chat opens once the finder confirms the match.
errors.not_confirmed: The finder hasn't confirmed this match yet.
errors.checklist_incomplete: Tick every required item before verifying.
errors.admin_only: Only the control room can do this.
errors.reveal_required: Tap to reveal the photo (this is logged).
errors.phone_in_use: That number belongs to another role.
errors.unsupported_kind: This kind of report isn't supported.

voice.holdOrTap: Hold to talk, or tap to start and stop
voice.denied: Microphone blocked. Allow it in your browser, or type instead.
voice.unsupported: This browser can't record audio. Please type instead.
voice.tooShort: That was too short. Hold the button and speak for a few seconds.
voice.silent: We couldn't hear anything. Check the microphone and speak close to the phone.

location.denied: Location is off. Drag the pin to where you are.
location.dragHint: Drag the pin if it's not exactly right.

photo.title: Take a photo of the child
photo.lead: The photo stays private. Only the safe point staff will see it.
photo.wrist: Number on the wrist? Photo it

about.girlNote: Girls are only handed to a {desk} with women staff.
about.under4Note: Very young children are handed straight to the safe point. The staff there take care of everything from that point.

voice.title: Tell us what happened
voice.lead: What is the child saying? Their name, their father's name, where they live. Speak in any language.
voice.typePlaceholder: e.g. Says her name is Ayesha, father Raza, lives near Hussain Agahi…

location.title: Where did you find the child?
location.privacy: The location is never shown to the public. Police are informed automatically.

safepoint.reported: Report #{id} sent. Police have a record.
safepoint.title: Take the child to a safe point
safepoint.girlsOnly: Only Behan Desk points (women staff) are shown for a girl.
safepoint.none: No suitable safe point nearby. Stay with the child; police have been informed.

handover.walkLead: Stay with the child until the staff accept them.
handover.waiting: Show the staff report #{id}. Waiting for them to accept the child…
handover.policeInformed: Police are kept informed at every step.
handover.thanks: Thank you. We'll ask you to confirm if a family is found.
handover.under4Thanks: Thank you. The staff will take it from here. You can leave now.
handover.reunitedThanks: You helped bring a child home. Thank you.
handover.blocked: The safe point stopped this handover. The child is safe with staff and police have been called.
handover.escalated: Police have taken over the search. Matching continues.
handover.verifying: The family is with the safe point staff now. They're checking everything.
handover.parentComing: The family is on their way to {place}.
handover.newReportNote: This report keeps going. You can open it again from "Your reports".

card.title: Check the details
card.lead: Tap anything that's wrong. Then ask the child the question below.
card.next: Next: take the child to safety

parent.title: Is your child missing?
parent.lead: Report them, or check what's happening.
parent.blocked: The safe point stopped this handover. Please speak to the staff or police.
parent.expired: This gate photo has been deleted (48 hours).
parent.escalated: Police have taken over the search. We're still matching.
parent.possibleExplain: We may have found your child. The person with them is checking your photo now.
parent.bringId: Bring your phone (with your child's photos) and the B-form if you have it.
parent.privacyNote: For the child's safety you won't see the photo or exact location until a safe point verifies you.

report.photoLead: From your gallery. Only the finder and safe point staff will see it.
report.voiceLead: Where were you, what happened, what they're wearing. Speak in any language.
report.whereTitle: Where did you last see them?
report.privacy: Police are informed automatically. Your number is never shown to anyone.

checkin.title: Today's photo
checkin.lead: One photo in today's clothes, at the gate. Deleted automatically after 48 hours.
checkin.doneLead: If your child gets lost, open this page and tap "My child is lost".
checkin.wristReminder: Write your phone number on your child's wrist.

sp.title: Safe point
sp.lead: Children coming here, and children in your care.
sp.finderDecides: The finder is checking this match. You can confirm it too if they've left.
sp.parentComing: Match confirmed. The family is on their way.
sp.startCheck: Family is here: start the check

admin.title: Control room
admin.noSafePoints: No safe points yet. Run the seed.
admin.flagsNote: Signals for a human to look at. Nothing is blocked or punished automatically.
admin.reportNote: Uses counts only. No names, photos or locations leave the system.
admin.resetConfirm: Delete ALL cases, chats and the audit log? Safe points and accounts are kept.

police.title: Police records
police.lead: Every report creates a record. It updates at every custody step.
police.simulated: Simulated police endpoint: the real integration is a partner step.
police.none: No records in the last 48 hours.
police.photoPolicy: Photos are hidden by default. Viewing one will be logged in the audit trail.
police.revealNote: Revealing a photo is recorded in the audit log.

finder.title: I found a child
finder.desc: Report a lost child in 30 seconds

parent.title: My child is missing
parent.desc: Report or check your child's status

admin.title: Control room
admin.desc: Live map, timers and audit log

chat.title: Private chat
chat.masked: We hid a phone number in your message. Please talk here instead.

match.title: Is this the child?
match.aiSuggests: The system only suggests. You decide.

handover.title: Handover checklist

items.gallery_photo_match: The parent's own phone photos show this child
items.child_reaction_ok: The child knows them and is happy to go
items.female_staff_present: A female staff member is present (me)

handover.needFemale: This is a girl: a female staff member must do this check.
handover.wrongExplain: The child stays here. Police are alerted immediately.

children.title: Saved children
children.lead: Save a photo now, so if your child ever goes missing you can report in one tap. Only you can see these.
children.consent: I am the parent or guardian and agree to store this photo privately. I can delete it any time.

install.title: Add Wapsi to your phone
install.lead: Opens full screen, one tap from your home screen.
install.ios: On iPhone: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.

autofill.working: AI is listening and filling in the details…
autofill.reviewLead: AI filled this in from what you said. Fix anything that's wrong, then continue.
autofill.manualLead: Fill in what you know. Boy or girl and age are needed.
autofill.noSpeech: We couldn't hear anyone speaking in that recording. Record again, close to the phone, or type instead.
autofill.unclear: The AI couldn't find details about a child in that. Please fill them in below.
autofill.partial: AI filled in only some details. Please check and complete the rest.
autofill.off: AI is not switched on, so please fill these in yourself. Your voice note is still sent.
autofill.failed: The AI couldn't read that just now. Please fill these in yourself. Your voice note is still sent.
autofill.typeMore: Write a few words about the child, or record a voice note.
autofill.needAge: Choose about how old the child is.
autofill.needAgeNumber: Enter the child's age in years (0 to 17).
autofill.badYear: Enter a birth year between the dates shown.
autofill.notImage: That file isn't a photo. Take or choose a photo.
autofill.fixErrors: Some details need fixing. Check the red messages above.

geofence.title: Missing children within {km} km ({n})
geofence.leadSp: Verified responders only. If a child like this is brought to you, accept them and Wapsi will match the family.
geofence.leadPolice: Every safe point within {km} km of the last-seen place has been alerted. The public is never alerted.
geofence.none: No missing children reported within {km} km.
